name: speakup
description: SpeakUp — personal local-first English speaking coach (M0 + M1)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix client && npm --prefix server run prisma:generate && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix client test && npm --prefix server test
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
